title: Drunk Mom Named ‘Margarita’ Crashed with Her Kid In The Car: Police
description:
A Texas woman was arrested after allegedly causing a rollover crash with her child in the car while drunk. According to the New Mexico State Police, Margarita Bautista, 48, was taken into custody after multiple witnesses reported a reckless driver. Witnesses told police Bautista was “all over the road,” before veering off and crashing in a field. The child was taken to the hospital and treated for injuries while Margarita was cuffed and taken to jail. The 48-year-old is facing multiple charges. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
